title: Circuit language and circuit value
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits in which every circuit has fan-in at most two, has no repeated arguments at any gate, and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. For every Boolean string $x$, the family accepts $x$ if and only if the encoding of the circuit for inputs of length $|x|$, paired with $x$, belongs to the circuit value language.
hypotheses_covered: Every circuit in $C$ has fan-in at most two
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
